_comment: Focus profiles — a soft lens over the tool registry, not a gate. Selecting a focus boosts in-focus tools (by category and/or server id) in search + cast ranking; out-of-focus tools stay reachable. Select via env CH1TTY_FOCUS=<name> or the per-call `focus` param on ch1tty/search and ch1tty/cast. Server ids and categories reference servers.json — profiles may name disabled/future servers (they simply won't match until present).

analytics.description: Data analytics — query metrics, aggregate events, and export reports via the analytics backend.

auth.description: Identity and access management — verify tokens, issue credentials, manage sessions, and trace auth flows across ChittyID

chittyevidence.description: Evidence corpus — ingest, search, and retrieve documents with canonical URIs via ChittyEvidence (apps/evidence-mcp)

cloud.description: Cloudflare platform — deploy, build, and manage Workers in production and staging environments

code.description: Software development — source control, issue tracking, deployment, library documentation, database, code quality, and technical documentation tools

communication.description: Cross-channel messaging, notes, team communication, and follow-up task creation

data.description: Database, storage, and filesystem tooling — Neon SQL queries, schema inspection, R2 object storage, and local filesystem operations

design.description: Browser rendering, automation, and desktop/visual work

finance.description: Billing, payments, ledger, and financial ecosystem tools

google.description: Google Workspace productivity and administration — Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Docs, and org-wide user/group management via Google Admin (GAM)

governance.description: ChittyOS ecosystem governance, identity, evidence, persistent state, sessions, and ledger

ledger.description: Append-only audit ledger — list namespaces, read entries, and append immutable records via ChittyLedger (apps/ledger-mcp)

legal.description: Legal operations — dispute management, resolution workflows, evidence retrieval, and audit-trail recording

market.description: Market research and pricing intelligence — search listings, track price history, compare offers, and summarise market conditions

monitoring.description: Service health, alerting, and observability — check endpoint health, query alert rules, and inspect uptime metrics across ChittyOS services

ops.description: Deployment, infrastructure monitoring, and DevOps tooling — Cloudflare Workers, database ops, source control, filesystem, and orchestration

realestate.description: Property management — list and inspect rental properties, tenants, leases, and maintenance requests via TurboTenant

search.description: Web and document search — query the evidence index, scrape pages, extract content, and surface research findings

session.description: Cross-channel session management — create, inspect, and close ChittyOS sessions; append and replay session event logs

tasks.description: Task management — create, update, list, and complete ChittyAgent Tasks
